draft.shortGloss: to not have; there is no
notes: Literal negation of มี (mii, 'to have / there is'). Placed directly before the noun that is lacking or absent.

senses.definition: To not own, hold, or possess something.

senses.definition: Used to say that something or someone is not present or does not exist.

examples.translation: There is no water in the fridge.
